about: Batch 04, slice A, chunk A35: lunch plates from Japan, Korea, Thailand, Malaysia and India (teishoku sets, kimbap, rice plates, nasi lemak, tiffin).

recipes.title: Shake Shioyaki Teishoku (Japanese Salted Grilled Salmon Set Lunch)
recipes.summary: Salted grilled salmon with rice, grated radish and a quick cucumber pickle, set out like a Japanese lunch counter.
steps: Rinse the rice, then cook it with 300ml water in a lidded pot for 12 minutes and rest it covered.
Salt the salmon on both sides and leave for 10 minutes while you pickle the cucumber with the vinegar and a pinch of salt.
Grill the fillets skin side up under a hot grill for 5 to 6 minutes until the skin blisters and the flesh flakes.
Serve the fish on plates with rice, a mound of grated daikon dressed with the soy sauce, the pickle and a lemon wedge.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and flaking, and keep raw fish below 5°C until it goes under the grill.
Contains fish, soy and gluten.

recipes.title: Buta no Shogayaki Teishoku (Ginger Pork Set Lunch)
recipes.summary: Thin pork slices in a sweet, sharp ginger and soy glaze, served with rice and shredded cabbage.
steps: Stir the soy sauce, mirin, ginger and sugar together.
Heat the oil in a large frying pan over high heat and fry the pork for 2 to 3 minutes until just browned.
Pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until glossy and the pork is cooked through.
Check the pork is cooked through with no pink and reaches 70°C, then serve over the warm rice with the raw cabbage alongside.
notes: Food safety: pork must be cooked through with no pink, and raw pork should be kept below 5°C until cooking.
Contains soy and gluten.

recipes.title: Tamagoyaki Teishoku (Rolled Omelette Set Lunch)
recipes.summary: A soft, lightly sweet rolled omelette with rice, spinach and pickled cucumber for a quiet vegetarian set lunch.
steps: Whisk the eggs with the soy sauce, mirin and sugar.
Wilt the spinach in a pan with a splash of water for 1 minute, squeeze dry and toss with the sesame seeds.
Oil a small non-stick pan over medium heat, pour in a third of the egg and roll it up as it sets, pushing it to one side.
Add more egg in two more rounds, rolling each time, until the omelette is set and golden, then slice into thick pieces.
Serve with the rice, spinach and the cucumber tossed in the vinegar.
notes: Food safety: cook the omelette until set throughout and don't serve it runny to young children or older adults.
Contains egg, soy, sesame and gluten.

recipes.title: Chicken Nanban (Japanese Fried Chicken with Tartare Sauce)
recipes.summary: Crisp chicken thigh dipped in a sweet-sour vinegar glaze, then spooned over with an egg tartare sauce.

items: 350g boneless chicken thigh, cut into pieces

steps: Dust the chicken in the flour, then dip it in the beaten egg.
Shallow-fry in the oil over medium heat for 6 to 7 minutes, turning, until golden and cooked through.
Warm the soy sauce, vinegar and sugar in a small pan until the sugar dissolves, then turn the hot chicken in it.
Mix the mayonnaise, boiled egg and pickles into a tartare sauce.
Serve the chicken over the rice with the tartare sauce spooned on top.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C inside with no pink, and don't reuse the raw egg bowl for the sauce.
Contains egg, gluten and soy.

recipes.title: Hiyashi Chuka (Japanese Cold Ramen Noodle Plate)
recipes.summary: Chilled noodles under neat rows of egg, ham, cucumber and tomato, finished with a sharp soy-vinegar dressing.
steps: Cook the noodles until tender as the packet says, rinse under cold water and drain well.
Beat the eggs, fry them in the oil as a thin omelette until set, then slice into ribbons.
Whisk the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and sesame oil with 2 tbsp water until the sugar dissolves.
Pile the noodles in two bowls and arrange the egg, ham, cucumber and tomato on top.
Pour over the dressing and scatter with the sesame seeds.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until set, and keep the ham and prepared plate below 5°C until you eat.
Contains gluten, egg, soy and sesame.

recipes.title: Soboro Don (Japanese Minced Chicken and Egg Rice Bowl)
recipes.summary: Sweet-salty minced chicken and fluffy scrambled egg over rice with green beans, a classic bento-style bowl.
steps: Simmer the chicken with the soy sauce, mirin, the first spoon of sugar and the ginger, stirring to keep it crumbly, for 6 minutes until the liquid has gone.
Beat the eggs with the second teaspoon of sugar and scramble them in a pan over low heat, stirring constantly, until small and just set.
Blanch the green beans for 3 minutes, drain and slice.
Divide the rice between two bowls and arrange the chicken, egg and beans in neat sections.
notes: Food safety: chicken mince must reach 75°C and be cooked until no pink remains; set the scrambled egg firm.
Contains egg, gluten and soy.

recipes.title: Korean Classic Kimbap with Egg and Pickled Radish
recipes.summary: Seaweed rolls of sesame rice filled with egg, carrot, spinach and pickled radish, sliced for a picnic lunch.
steps: Toss the warm rice with the sesame oil and the salt and let it cool a little.
Beat the eggs, fry them thinly in the vegetable oil until set and cut into long strips.
Stir-fry the carrot for 2 minutes, and wilt the spinach with a splash of water, squeezing it dry.
Spread a third of the rice over each nori sheet, leaving a gap at the top, and lay the egg, carrot, spinach and radish in a line across the middle.
Roll up tightly, brush the end with water to seal, and slice into rounds with a sharp wet knife until you have 8 per roll.
notes: Food safety: cool the rice quickly, refrigerate within 1 hour and eat within 4 hours out of the fridge, as cooked rice left warm can grow Bacillus cereus.
Contains egg and sesame.

recipes.title: Tuna Mayo Kimbap
recipes.summary: Rice and seaweed rolls filled with creamy tuna mayo, cucumber and carrot, an easy kimbap to start with.
steps: Mix the rice with the sesame oil and sesame seeds.
Mash the tuna with the mayonnaise.
Spread rice over each nori sheet, leaving a gap at the top, and line up the tuna, cucumber and carrot across the middle.
Roll tightly until firm, seal the edge with a dab of water and slice into rounds.
notes: Food safety: canned tuna mayo should be kept below 5°C and eaten within 4 hours out of the fridge.
Contains fish, egg and sesame.

recipes.title: Bulgogi Kimbap
recipes.summary: Sweet soy-marinated beef, cooked fast and rolled in rice and seaweed with crunchy vegetables.
steps: Toss the beef with the soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil and garlic and leave for 15 minutes.
Fry the beef in the vegetable oil over high heat for 3 minutes until cooked through and the liquid has reduced.
Wilt the spinach with a splash of water, squeeze dry and season with a pinch of salt.
Spread rice over each nori sheet and line up the beef, carrot, cucumber and spinach.
Roll tightly, seal with water and slice into rounds.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef through until no pink remains, and keep raw meat below 5°C until cooking.
Contains soy, sesame and gluten.

recipes.title: Korean Jajangmyeon Black Bean Noodles
recipes.summary: Thick noodles in a glossy, savoury black bean sauce with pork and vegetables, a favourite Korean lunch.
steps: Fry the black bean paste in the oil for 2 minutes to cook out the rawness, then stir in the pork and brown it.
Add the onion, potato and 300ml water, cover and simmer 10 minutes, then add the zucchini and sugar for 4 minutes more.
Stir the cornflour into 2 tbsp cold water, pour it in and simmer until the sauce thickens and shines.
Boil the noodles until tender as the packet says and drain well.
Pile the noodles in bowls, spoon over the sauce and top with cucumber.
notes: Food safety: pork mince must reach 75°C and be cooked until no pink remains.
Contains gluten and soy.

recipes.title: Bibim Guksu (Korean Spicy Cold Noodles)
recipes.summary: Chilled wheat noodles tossed in a sweet, hot gochujang sauce with crunchy cucumber and a boiled egg.
steps: Boil the noodles for 3 to 4 minutes, rinse under cold water until cool and drain very well.
Stir the gochujang, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and sesame oil into a sauce.
Toss the noodles with the sauce and the cucumber.
Serve topped with the eggs, spring onion and sesame seeds.
notes: Food safety: boil the eggs for at least 8 minutes so they are firm, and keep the dish below 5°C if it sits.
Contains gluten, egg, soy and sesame.

recipes.title: Dakgalbi Lettuce Wraps (Korean Spicy Chicken Wraps)
recipes.summary: Sticky gochujang chicken with cabbage and sweet potato, spooned into crisp lettuce cups with rice.
steps: Mix the gochujang, soy sauce, honey and garlic and coat the chicken.
Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium heat, add the sweet potato and 60ml water, cover and cook 5 minutes.
Add the chicken and cabbage and cook, stirring, for 8 to 10 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce is sticky.
Spoon into lettuce leaves with a little rice.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C with no pink, and wash hands and board after handling it raw.
Contains soy and gluten.

recipes.title: Thai Omelette Rice (Khai Jiao Rice Plate)
recipes.summary: A puffed, crisp-edged Thai omelette over steamed rice with sweet chilli sauce and cucumber.
steps: Beat the eggs with the fish sauce and lime juice until frothy.
Heat the oil in a wok until very hot, then pour in the egg from a height so it puffs and crisps at the edges.
Cook 1 minute, flip, cook 30 seconds and lift out onto paper towel.
Serve over rice with cucumber and sweet chilli sauce.
notes: Food safety: cook the omelette until fully set, and take care with hot oil.
Contains fish (fish sauce) and egg.

recipes.title: Nasi Lemak with Ayam Goreng Berempah (Fried Chicken)
recipes.summary: Coconut rice with spiced fried chicken, sambal, cucumber, peanuts and egg for a Malaysian lunch plate.
steps: Rinse the rice, then cook with the coconut milk, 200ml water, bay leaf and salt in a lidded pot for 14 minutes and rest covered.
Rub the chicken with the turmeric, coriander, cumin and salt and leave 15 minutes.
Shallow-fry the chicken in 1 cm of oil over medium heat for 18 to 20 minutes, turning, until golden and cooked through.
Serve with the rice, eggs, cucumber, peanuts and sambal.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C at the bone with clear juices; cook the eggs until firm.
Contains egg and peanuts.

recipes.title: Nasi Lemak Vegetarian Plate with Crisp Tofu
recipes.summary: Fragrant coconut rice with crisp tofu, sambal, peanuts, cucumber and a fried egg.
steps: Cook the rinsed rice with the coconut milk, 150ml water and bay leaf in a lidded pot for 14 minutes, then rest covered.
Fry the tofu in half the oil for 3 minutes each side until crisp.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil until the whites are set.
Plate the rice with tofu, egg, cucumber, peanuts and sambal.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the white is fully set.
Contains egg, soy and peanuts.

recipes.title: Nasi Goreng Kampung (Malaysian Village Fried Rice)
recipes.summary: Smoky anchovy and chilli fried rice with greens and a fried egg, a Malaysian kampung staple.
steps: Fry the anchovies in 1 tbsp oil for 1 minute until crisp, then add the garlic and chilli for 30 seconds.
Add the cold rice and stir-fry over high heat for 3 minutes.
Add the greens and soy sauce and toss for 1 minute.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil until the whites are set and serve on top.
notes: Food safety: use rice cooled quickly and refrigerated within 1 hour of cooking, and cook the eggs until set.
Contains fish (anchovies), egg, soy and gluten.

recipes.title: Mee Goreng Mamak (Malaysian Spicy Fried Noodles)
recipes.summary: Yellow noodles wok-tossed with chilli paste, tofu, egg and tomato, the way the mamak stalls do it.
steps: Fry the tofu in the oil over high heat until golden, then push aside.
Add the chilli paste and fry for 30 seconds, then crack in the eggs and scramble until set.
Add the noodles, soy sauce and tomato sauce and toss for 3 minutes.
Add the tomato and choy sum and toss 2 minutes more.
Add the tomato and bok choy and toss 2 minutes more until the greens wilt, then serve with lime wedges.
notes: Food safety: cook the egg until set before adding the noodles.
Contains gluten, egg and soy.

recipes.title: Indian Lemon Rice Tiffin Box
recipes.summary: Tangy turmeric rice with peanuts, curry leaf and mustard seeds, packed with cucumber and yoghurt for the tiffin.
steps: Heat the oil, then add the mustard seeds and let them pop.
Add the peanuts, curry leaf and chilli and fry for 1 minute.
Stir in the turmeric and the rice and toss over medium heat for 3 minutes.
Add the lemon juice and salt to taste and toss until the rice is evenly coloured.
Pack with the yoghurt and cucumber in the tiffin.
notes: Food safety: cool the rice quickly and keep the tiffin in an insulated bag with an ice pack, eating within 4 hours.
Contains peanuts, milk and mustard.

recipes.title: Curd Rice Tiffin (Thayir Sadam with Pickle)
recipes.summary: Cool, creamy South Indian yoghurt rice tempered with mustard and curry leaf, packed with a spoon of pickle.
steps: Mash the warm rice with the yoghurt, milk and salt until soft and creamy.
Heat the oil, pop the mustard seeds, then add the curry leaf and ginger for 20 seconds.
Pour the tempering over the rice and stir in the grated carrot.
Serve at room temperature with the pickle.
notes: Food safety: keep it chilled and eat within 4 hours out of the fridge, as dairy-based rice spoils quickly in warm weather.
Contains milk and mustard.

recipes.title: Masala Dosa with Coconut Chutney Lunch Plate (Quick Batter)
recipes.summary: Crisp rice and lentil crepes folded around a turmeric potato filling and served with a quick coconut chutney.
steps: Fry the mustard seeds in the oil for the filling, add the onion and chilli until soft, then the turmeric and potato with a splash of water; mash lightly and season.
Blend the coconut, chilli, lemon juice and water into a chutney.
Whisk the rice flour, semolina, plain flour, 400ml water and a pinch of salt into a thin batter and rest it while you make the filling. Heat a non-stick pan and pour a ladle in a thin lacy circle.
Cook until crisp and golden underneath, spoon in the filling, fold and serve with the chutney.
notes: Contains mustard and gluten.
Ready-made dosa batter is sold chilled in Indian grocers.

recipes.title: Rava Upma Tiffin with Vegetables
recipes.summary: Soft, savoury semolina cooked with mustard seed, ginger and vegetables, a South Indian tiffin staple.
steps: Dry-roast the semolina in a pan for 3 to 4 minutes until it smells nutty, then set aside.
Heat the oil, pop the mustard seeds, then add the onion, ginger, curry leaf and carrot for 3 minutes.
Add the peas and the water with a teaspoon of salt and bring to the boil until bubbling.
Pour in the semolina in a steady stream, stirring, then cover and cook 2 minutes.
Finish with the lemon juice.
notes: Contains gluten and mustard.

recipes.title: Poha with Peanuts and Lemon (Maharashtrian Flattened Rice)
recipes.summary: Light, turmeric-yellow flattened rice with onion, peanuts and lemon, a quick Indian lunch box favourite.
steps: Rinse the poha in a sieve until just soft and drain well.
Heat the oil, pop the mustard seeds and fry the peanuts for 1 minute.
Add the onion, chilli and curry leaf for 3 minutes, then the turmeric.
Stir in the poha and salt, and cook gently 3 minutes.
Finish with lemon juice and coriander.
notes: Contains peanuts and mustard.

recipes.title: Vegetable Uttapam (South Indian Savoury Pancake)
recipes.summary: Thick, soft rice and lentil pancakes studded with onion, tomato and chilli.
steps: Whisk the rice flour, semolina, plain flour, water and a pinch of salt into a thick pourable batter, then rest it while you chop. Mix the onion, tomato, chilli and coriander together.
Heat a non-stick pan with a little oil and pour on a ladle of batter, spreading it only slightly so it stays thick.
Scatter a handful of the vegetables over the top and press them in.
Drizzle oil around the edge, cook 3 minutes, flip and cook 2 minutes more until golden, then serve with the chutney.
notes: Ready-made dosa batter is sold chilled in Indian grocers.

recipes.title: Besan Chilla (Chickpea Flour Pancakes)
recipes.summary: Savoury gram flour pancakes with onion, tomato and spices, served with a mint yoghurt dip.
steps: Whisk the chickpea flour with the water, cumin, turmeric and a pinch of salt into a smooth batter.
Stir in the onion, tomato, chilli and coriander.
Cook ladlefuls in a lightly oiled non-stick pan for 3 minutes each side until golden and set.
Stir the mint into the yoghurt and serve alongside.
notes: Contains milk.

recipes.title: Egg Kathi Roll (Calcutta Style)
recipes.summary: A beaten egg cooked onto a flaky paratha with onion, lime and chilli, rolled up as a street-style lunch.
steps: Toss the onion with the chilli, lime juice and garam masala.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Cook a paratha in a hot pan with a little oil, pour half the egg over the top side, flip once it sets and cook until the egg is set, about 1 minute.
Spread with chutney, add the onion mix and roll up tightly in baking paper.
Repeat for the second roll.
notes: Food safety: cook the egg until set throughout.
Contains egg, gluten and milk.
